note: A lenient parser (for example the csv module) passes the visible tests; hidden tests cover the strict error rules, untrimmed fields and the quoting rules of the formatter.

twin_breaks.rule: Right after the closing quote comes the delimiter or the end of the text. Anything else raises `ValueError`
A quoted field that never closes raises `ValueError`
A `"` anywhere inside an unquoted field raises `ValueError`
`"\n"` or `"\r"` outside a quoted field raises `ValueError`
or when it starts or ends with a space
Every other field, the empty string included, is written without quotes
`fields` must hold at least one field, and every field must be a `str`. Otherwise `ValueError`
